title: SPARSEUP: Towards Better Recipes for Training Modern Learned Sparse Retrievers
abstract: arXiv:2611.09680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned sparse embeddings are a powerful alternative to dense retrieval, yet they have fallen behind single-vector and late interaction models. One reason for their limited adoption is that they are notoriously difficult to train, generally requiring very tight conditions to converge. We present a recipe for training Splade-like encoders on modern backbones and data that achieves a better efficiency-effectiveness trade-off. We discuss the role of logit distribution and its impact on the training stability and the final sparsity of the encoder. We also introduce a new per-position fan-out control - a hard cap on how many vocabulary dimensions each position may emit. We further apply a simple vocabulary merging strategy that removes redundant entries - such as case and word-boundary variants of the same word - which are common in cased BPE-based backbones. translated_title: SPARSEUP：面向现代学习型稀疏检索器训练的更优方案
translated_abstract: 学习型稀疏嵌入是稠密检索的一种强大替代方案，然而其发展已落后于单向量模型和迟交互模型。其应用受限的原因之一在于它们以难以训练而著称，通常需要非常严格的条件才能收敛。我们提出了一套在现代骨干网络和数据上训练 Splade 类编码器的完整方案，能够实现更优的效率与效果权衡。我们讨论了 logit 分布的作用及其对训练稳定性和编码器最终稀疏性的影响。我们还引入了一种新的逐位置扇出控制机制，即对每个位置可以激活的词汇维度数量设置硬性上限。此外，我们进一步应用了一种简单的词汇表合并策略，用于去除冗余词条，例如同一单词的大小写变体和词边界变体，这类冗余在基于区分大小写 BPE 的骨干网络中十分常见。我们将该方案应用于 LateOn 骨干网络和训练数据，由此得到了 SPARSEUP 模型。
tldr: 本文提出 SPARSEUP 训练方案，通过 logit 分布调控、逐位置扇出硬上限以及词汇表合并策略，让基于现代骨干网络的 Splade 类稀疏检索器实现更优的效率-效果权衡。
en_tdlr: SPARSEUP introduces a training recipe for modern Splade-like learned sparse retrievers—featuring logit distribution control, per-position fan-out capping, and vocabulary merging—that achieves a better efficiency-effectiveness trade-off.
